local.rationale: The worker admissibly resolves only Q1 (1/3): having read transform.py, it cannot author the E-B clean-room implementation, so Q2 is inadmissible and the Q3 verdict cannot follow from E-B (delta_e ~ 0.5*0.33 + 0.5*0.9 novel records). Its own analysis records are first-production, so redundancy is near zero.

local-independent-verify.rationale: The examiner also reads the package (including transform.py) and sees the answer, so it is equally contaminated for E-B; admissible resolution stays at 1/3 while its re-check records largely duplicate the worker's Q1 analysis, raising redundancy without adding admissible evidence.

isolated-child.rationale: The worker can hand the isolated child migrate.md alone (excluding transform.py and its own conclusions), exactly satisfying E-B's never-accessed authorship condition; with the root's mechanical comparison, all three distinctions resolve admissibly (3/3) and the child's implementation and comparison records are required, hence novel. Small residual for the child misreading the spec-shaped instructions.

branching.rationale: The admissibility structure makes the isolated-child branch the only one that can satisfy E-B, so a run-time worker should realize it and match isolated-child's outcome; slightly discounted for the chance the worker wrongly realizes the local branch after judging its own comparison sufficient.
